meta.name: debug
meta.description: Debug container agent issues. Use when things aren't working, container fails, authentication problems, or to understand how the container system works. Covers logs, session DBs, mounts, and common issues.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 排查容器和 agent 运行问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常遇到容器或 agent 运行异常需要定位根因
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to diagnose container or agent runtime problems

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 按此指南排查 NanoClaw 容器代理故障:查主机日志、两个会话数据库、挂载与心跳,定位消息未送达、容器立即退出、鉴权失败等问题。
howto.when: 当容器不工作、容器失败或鉴权出问题时触发,也用于了解容器系统的运作方式。

say.text: 机器人不回复了,帮我查日志和会话数据库
say.note: 会先看主机错误日志与会话 DB

say.text: 容器一启动就退出、没有回复,帮我排查
say.note: 会查容器退出码和 streamed stderr

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude follows this guide to debug NanoClaw container agent issues: reading host logs, the two session DBs, mounts, and heartbeats to locate undelivered messages, containers that exit immediately, and auth failures.
howto.when_en: Triggers when things aren't working, a container fails, auth problems appear, or you want to understand how the container system works.

say_en.text: The bot stopped replying, check the logs and session DBs
say_en.note: Starts with the host error log and session DBs

say_en.text: The container exits immediately with no reply, help me debug
say_en.note: Checks exit code and streamed stderr

say_en.text: The OneCLI gateway seems unreachable, check 127.0.0.1:10254
